name: Kimen
history: Kimen es un grupo activo desde 2013, de estilo death metal melódico con influencias Sound of Silence, The Black Dahlia Murder, At the Gates, As Hope Dies y As Blood Runs Black.
historyEn: Kimen is a band active since 2013, of melodic death metal style with influences Sound of Silence, The Black Dahlia Murder, At the Gates and As Blood Runs Black.
